result.narrative:
Vodafone Idea sits in the Watch band with a score of 25.5, driven by a modest overdue (18 days past due) on its single scored exposure and a severity-2 news item on subscriber decline. While the headline numbers are not alarming in isolation, the payment record shows a deteriorating trend and the news flow includes a second severity-2 item (a wider-than-expected Q2 loss) alongside the scored subscriber-decline story, both pointing to continuing operational and financial pressure.

The band reflects the formula combining the 18 DPD payment signal (weighted 11.7) with the subscriber-decline article (weighted 13.8). The adjudicator agreed with the score but flagged caveats: resolution times on prior overdues have lengthened each cycle (5 days, then 9, now 18 and still open), notification frequency has risen from 1 to 2 in six months, and a second negative earnings article reinforces the risk picture. The adjudicator also noted that several positive developments (including $3.5B in SBI-led debt financing and bullish analyst targets) are scored severity 0 and so do not offset the risk signal in the formula, even though they are credit-relevant context.

The recommended action is to maintain the current limit of 120,000,000 INR on policy TCI-SCF-2026-0001, as the probability of default (0.1552) remains within appetite against the 0.25 PD target; no change in exposure is proposed.

A move to the lower Healthy band would require the score to fall by 5.5 points, consistent with resolving the current overdue and no fresh negative news. Conversely, continued deterioration in days-past-due (reaching 43 DPD) or additional negative news would push the score 24.5 points higher into the High Risk band, so the lengthening overdue-resolution trend and any repeat earnings or subscriber weakness are the key things to watch.
